caption: After a double tap on the paragraph, the note stays in Reading view.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['reading-tap-guard'].settings.action='nothing';document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview'}}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); window.getSelection().removeAllRanges(); const v=l.view; const p=[...v.containerEl.querySelectorAll('.markdown-reading-view p')].find(e=>e.textContent.startsWith('Double tap')); const n=p.firstChild; const at=(w)=>{const i=n.nodeValue.indexOf(w); const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(n,i); r.setEnd(n,i+w.length); const b=r.getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.left+b.width/2,b.top+b.height/2];};const tap=(x,y)=>{for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const el=document.elementFromPoint(x,y);const init={pointerType:'touch',pointerId:60+i,button:0,buttons:1,isPrimary:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,clientX:x,clientY:y};el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',init));el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{...init,buttons:0}));el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:x,clientY:y}));}}; const [x,y]=at('paragraph'); tap(x,y); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000)); const m=v.getMode(); if (m!=='preview') throw new Error('mode '+m); return m; })()

caption: One tap on a link in Reading view opens the linked note.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview'}}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); window.getSelection().removeAllRanges(); const v=l.view; const p=[...v.containerEl.querySelectorAll('.markdown-reading-view p')].find(e=>e.textContent.startsWith('Double tap')); const n=p.firstChild; const at=(w)=>{const i=n.nodeValue.indexOf(w); const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(n,i); r.setEnd(n,i+w.length); const b=r.getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.left+b.width/2,b.top+b.height/2];};const tap=(x,y,k)=>{for(let i=0;i<k;i++){const el=document.elementFromPoint(x,y);const init={pointerType:'touch',pointerId:60+i,button:0,buttons:1,isPrimary:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,clientX:x,clientY:y};el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',init));el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{...init,buttons:0}));el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:x,clientY:y}));}}; const a=v.containerEl.querySelector('a.internal-link[data-href="Target"]'); const b=a.getBoundingClientRect(); tap(b.left+b.width/2,b.top+b.height/2,1); for (let i=0;i<30 && app.workspace.getActiveFile()?.path!=='Target.md';i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const f=app.workspace.getActiveFile()?.path; if (f!=='Target.md') throw new Error('open '+f); const l2=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s2=l2.getViewState(); await l2.setViewState({...s2,state:{...s2.state,mode:'preview'}}); return f; })()

caption: With Select the word, a double tap selects the word and the note stays in Reading view.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['reading-tap-guard'].settings.action='select-word';document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview'}}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); window.getSelection().removeAllRanges(); const v=l.view; const p=[...v.containerEl.querySelectorAll('.markdown-reading-view p')].find(e=>e.textContent.startsWith('Double tap')); const n=p.firstChild; const at=(w)=>{const i=n.nodeValue.indexOf(w); const r=document.createRange(); r.setStart(n,i); r.setEnd(n,i+w.length); const b=r.getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.left+b.width/2,b.top+b.height/2];};const tap=(x,y)=>{for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const el=document.elementFromPoint(x,y);const init={pointerType:'touch',pointerId:60+i,button:0,buttons:1,isPrimary:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,clientX:x,clientY:y};el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',init));el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{...init,buttons:0}));el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:x,clientY:y}));}}; const [x,y]=at('quick'); tap(x,y); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const t=window.getSelection().toString(); if (t!=='quick') throw new Error('selection '+t); if (v.getMode()!=='preview') throw new Error('mode'); return t; })()

caption: The setting picks what a double tap does in Reading view. Do nothing is the default.
eval: (async () => { app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('reading-tap-guard'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const t=document.querySelector('.modal.mod-settings')?.textContent??''; if (!t.includes('Double tap in reading view')) throw new Error('no setting'); return 'ok'; })()
